name: Say That You Hate Me
source:
You're on a walk when you notice your Fiancé sleeping beneath the tree, you approach him only to find out the truth he's been hiding. 

Make sure to look away! 
(His attitude changes *wink*)

[From [url=https://writer31.itch.io/say-that-you-hate-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
外出散步时，你偶然看见未婚夫正靠在树下熟睡；你走上前去，却意外撞破了他一直隐瞒至今的秘密。

千万记得移开视线哦！
（他的态度可是会大变样哦～眨眼）

[摘自[url=https://writer31.itch.io/say-that-you-hate-me]itch.io[/url]]
